Tom — thanks for the clear outline. We can absolutely support the configuration you described.

Quick summary of what I propose (we'll put formal details in the SOW):
- Commercial: 12-month renewal with a reserved EU node (dedicated capacity SKU) + an APAC hot-standby lane billed as standby burst capacity. We can include a 15% uplift on standard unit rates for onshore EU node hosting and a negotiated burst rate for APAC that only applies when standby is activated.
- Performance: For failover, we’ll pre-warm KV caches for the most common prefixes and provide a warm-start SLA target of 200ms p95 for APAC initial token latency. There will be a 48-hour stabilization SLA during the first 30 days of activation with operational runbook.
- Resilience: automated routing policy + fallback to hosted-compatible model variants. Rollback window: 30 minutes for automated fallback policy, manual rollback option in Console.
- Compliance: EU node will be deployed in a sovereign tenancy (customer-managed encryption keys supported).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Draft MAP with milestones (SOW, security review, PO, node provisioning, pilot) — target sign in 3–4 weeks.
2) Draft SOW (I attached a short proposal) for commercial review.
3) Set a 30-day pilot window post-provisioning to validate performance and KV-warm behavior.

I attached a concise proposal and a draft SOW template to get procurement moving. Can you confirm procurement contact and preferred kickoff window?

Best,
